get.description:
Requires an authenticated patient (any valid access token; no further permission —
the content is general and identical for everyone). Served from a static file for now
(placeholder copy); partner content replaces it with the same shape and a new
`version`. Send the last `ETag` as `If-None-Match` to get 304 when
nothing changed.

post.description: Creates a pending link from the caller to the account that owns the scanned profile QR. The jti is resolved once; the link then binds to the two account ids.
post.summary: Request a family link by profile-QR jti

get.description: Newest first, paged. Filter with ?status=pending for open requests. Each item shows the requester's @handle and display name.
Newest first, paged, optional ?status filter. Shows pending → linked without revealing the recipient before approval.
get.summary: List outgoing family-link requests and links

delete.summary: Cancel or unlink a family link

post.description: pending → linked. Records the recipient's consent and, if sent, their device public key.

get.summary: Get the sealed emergency card shared with me

put.description: ECIES: X25519 + HKDF-SHA256 (info balsm-family-card-v1, salt = link id) + AES-256-GCM, AAD = link id | owner user id | version. The server stores the envelope only.
put.summary: Share (or refresh) my sealed emergency card on a link
Upload this device's public key for a link

get.description: Incremental sync feed. Tombstoned rows are returned with is_deleted=true so a delete on one device propagates to the others.
get.summary: Pull care-team rows changed since a cursor

post.description: Idempotent on id so an at-least-once outbox drain cannot duplicate. A tombstoned id is refused with 409 rather than resurrected.
